raw_segments.text: at once with joy and fear his heart rebounds. Thus incorporeal spirits to smallest forms
reduced their shapes immense, and were at large, though without number still, amidst
the hall of that infernal court. But far within, and in their own dimensions like themselves,
the great seraphic lords and cherubim in close recess and secret conclave sat, a thousand
demigods on golden seats, frequent and full. After short silence then, and summons read,
